label: ①コスト妥当：堅実に光る
add: PLAN "STANDARD" (reasonable cost, solid and bright): A clean rectangular layout mostly reusing modular Re-booth parts. The NOC screen is built from SEVERAL medium flat-panel monitors in a tidy video-wall grid (3-4 screens), NOT one giant wall. Fabric membrane backlit only at key focal points (behind the screen grid and around the counter); remaining walls are clean flat printed brand panels in navy with blue/purple accents. One single LED-lit logo cube near the entrance corner. Top of the truss carries a simple flat illuminated logo sign. Restrained, professional, clearly a refreshed modular booth.

label: ②コスト高め：全面発光の洗練
add: PLAN "PREMIUM" (higher cost, fully-glowing sophistication): The ENTIRE truss canopy is wrapped in tensioned fabric membrane fully backlit from inside, glowing evenly like a lantern. The NOC screen is ONE large seamless slightly-curved LED video wall filling the main wall. A glowing illuminated RING/halo sign hovers overhead at centre, plus a suspended hanging logo. The explanation counter has a fully luminous LED top. Meeting zone uses semi-private low-partition pods with higher-end designer low furniture. Floor is full tile carpet with recessed glowing light-lines in blue/purple. Premium, immersive glow, the most polished option.

label: ③奇抜：∞（無限大）の光のゲート
add: PLAN "IMPACT" (bold/unconventional hero): The hero is a LARGE three-dimensional glowing INFINITY (figure-eight) GATE at the open corner, big enough to walk through and be framed by; inside the loop, animated light streaks represent energy flowing, pulsing vibrant blue to purple. NOC content shown on a CURVED/cylindrical multi-facet LED for immersion. Dynamic pulsing energetic lighting. Meeting and presentation zones sit calmly beneath the glowing loop. Still built from truss + membrane + LED (buildable/reusable), but the infinity-loop form makes it the most unconventional, eye-catching booth in the hall.
